title: Barnard's Star
blurb: The fastest-moving star in our sky, caught a year apart.
story: Barnard's Star is a small red star only six light-years away. It crosses the sky faster than any other star: about 10 arcseconds a year. Watch the bright star in the middle step upward (north) between August 2025 and September 2026 while everything else stays still.
name: Barnard's Star
